title: Nano Banana Pro
description: Nano Banana Pro is Google's new state-of-the-art image generation and editing model

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.15 per image. For $1.00, you can run this model 7 times. 4K outputs will be charged at double the standard rate. If web search is used, an additional $0.015 will be charged. Note: Pricing may change in the future.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed for the random number generator. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

inputs.name: system_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers). Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: The resolution of the image to generate.

inputs.name: limit_generations
inputs.tooltip: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate.

inputs.name: enable_web_search
inputs.tooltip: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
